title: What do you Guys think about
author: Background_Ranger667
selftext: I need some Feedback, is this ui looking good?

comments.body: It is still in its early stages, and it is my first project. 😂

comments.body:
Not bad for a first project, you'll learn a lot while doing it  
Nothing new when it comes to game design, but again, great project to learn with!
